item.title: Python Removing from List
item.author: emecas
item.description:
Python Remove from List
Removing items from a list while a loop runs over that same list skips items. Instead, collect the items to remove in a second list and remove them after the loop. Here, a mouse-click handler from Rice University’s interactive Python course, written in CodeSkulptor: a click on a ball removes it, a click anywhere else adds a new ball.
Never Remove anything from a List that you are iterating on instead mark it and remove later
The Python tutorial, “for Statements”: https://docs.python.org/3/tutorial/controlflow.html#for-statements
